entities.name: Al-Hakim al-Samarqandi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Al-Hakim Abu al-Qasim Ishaq al-Samarqandi, was a Sunni-Hanafi scholar, qadi (judge), and sage from Transoxania who studied Sufism in Balkh with Abu Bakr al-Warraq. Some sources describe him as a student of al-Maturidi in fiqh and kalam.
